careerMatcher.weightedFormula: Weighted rule-based formula: skill + language + experience + budget + priority alignment. No AI-generated scores - the same profile always produces the same result.
careerMatcher.title: Career & Country Matcher
careerMatcher.subtitle: Realistic country and job options ranked against your saved profile by a transparent, rule-based scoring engine - no forms to fill again, no black-box scores.
careerMatcher.scoresDisclaimer: Scores come from your saved profile checked against a curated dataset of migration corridors (BMET demand patterns, embassy rules, BOESL postings). Salary and cost figures are estimates tagged with their source and verification date - always confirm with BMET or the destination embassy before paying anyone.
careerMatcher.sliderHint: Drag the sliders toward what matters most to you - the ranking below re-orders instantly.
